newsitem.title: UK: Jersey in $1 mln drug award from US Treasury fund.
newsitem.headline: Jersey in $1 mln drug award from US Treasury fund.

text.p: Police in the British Channel island of Jersey have been awarded $1.0 million by the United States for helping to track down proceeds of international drug trafficking.

A statement from the States of Jersey said the award from the U.S. Treasury Forfeiture Fund represented part of the drug money confiscated by the U.S. authorities through legal proceedings in San Francisco.
A police spokesman said the last time Jersey had received a similar award for helping in a U.S. investigation was two years ago. He described the latest payment as "large for this island".
The award relates specifically to an investigation started in 1989 by US Customs, following disclosure by a Jersey-based Trust Company of the suspicious activities of two US clients.
The disclosure was made to the Jersey police. No further details were available.

Jersey authorities said the $1.0 million award would be placed in the States of Jersey Drug Trafficking Confiscations Fund, which is used for preventing and suppressing drug trafficking and for addressing the consequences of drug misuse.
